WITH bond_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END as element1,
    CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END as element2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    element1,
    element2,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM bond_pairs
  GROUP BY element1, element2
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(count) FROM pair_counts) as max_count,
    COUNT(*) as total_bonds
  FROM bond_pairs
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(max_count * 100.0 / total_bonds, 2) as percentage
FROM totals
